description:
Reconnect a number that is currently offline.

Uses the credentials already stored for the number, so no QR code and no
human are involved. Use it when `get_number` reports `disconnected` and
you want to send.

Returns immediately, before the connection is established. The answer
has the number's `alias`, `status` set to `connecting` and `at`, the
moment the request was accepted. The number reaches `connected` a few
seconds later: poll `get_number`, which stays the source of the current
status and of its own `at`, rather than assuming it worked.

It works the same on every number and never charges. On an extra number
scheduled for removal it does not change the removal: the number keeps
working until its date. Cancelling a removal is not available to agents.

This cannot rescue a `revoked` number: that one was unlinked from the
phone and needs a person to pair it again.

Calling it again changes nothing further. A number that is already
`connected` or `connecting` answers with an `already_connected` or
`already_connecting` error, which means the goal is met, not that the
call failed.

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
